about_the_game:
ULTIMATE AUTO-RPG: THE BEASTMASTER adds 1 new playable class "The Beastmaster" with a unique set of skills and 3 new special pets. By buying this DLC you are first and foremost showing your support for Ultimate Auto-RPG and future development but you also get a load of exclusive bonus content.

PLAYABLE CLASS

  • Hunter
  • Beastmaster (Subclass)

NEW PETS

  • Sabertooth
  • Spider
  • Dragon

BEASTMASTER
The beastmasters skill in training wild animals was famous in all the lands. Their guild was located at the green gate in a jungle on the border to Kintanu Islands. In this jungle there was five great wild beasts. The attempt to tame these great beasts was a struggle that went on for many years. The troll king sent his most skilled beastmaster the orc Babuul to tame the five great beasts and bring them to his palace.
